entries.title: Obscure

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC; PCSX2/xemu only for console comparison
emulation.notes: Use the Steam PC version for the primary route. Emulate console versions only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC/Steam release is the best primary route because it is the current official PC version of Obscure, while the PS2 and Xbox versions have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Obscure on Steam and look into compatibility tweaks if needed. Use PS2 or Xbox only for original-console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Steam version is a modern PC availability route, not a full remake; check compatibility notes before capture.

primary.why: The Windows PC/Steam release is the best primary route because it is the current official PC version of Obscure II, while the PS2, Wii, and PSP versions have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
